authority: Expectations frozen independently from adopted constraints and inspected source. Candidate must map every case to its exact norm; future adapters require separate independent review. This file implements no resolver or harness.
scope: Finite synthetic text/data topology, never created at these absolute host paths. No full operational positive, H0, product behavior or current-host claim.

base.lookup_default: ENOENT only for absent entries in this closed synthetic model
base.guards: exact all entries plus first-missing witnesses; no unknown entries

mutation_contract: Each control starts from an independent deep copy of BASE and applies only its listed exact_changes/fault_events in order. set_entry replaces exactly the named synthetic record. declare_out_of_scope narrows only the explicitly named primitive test, never a full plan. Cases are design expectations, not observations.
identity_contract: Seven tuple fields are st_dev, st_ino, st_mode, st_nlink, st_size, st_mtime_ns, st_ctime_ns. Exact values are synthetic and unrelated to current host. Parent nofollow observations bracket every read/open; fstat identity agrees; named namespace is rewalked before acceptance. All acquired descriptors close exactly once on every outcome.
bound_contract: Retain inherited 4096 path length/128 components/40 alias hops/32768 guard rows and timing/byte bounds. New finite exception may tighten ceilings, never widen them. Unknown edges refuse before lookup; cycles need not reach a generic depth error.
diagnostic_contract: CHI-* is the exact required category unless same_object_callback_exception or null external-review decision. Human boundary labels here identify the primitive and do not invent a production rule_id. Later exact candidate review binds rule_id/stage details without altering these expectations.
process_count_contract: Counts are planned outcomes at the named future synthetic/mock boundary. All actual executions in this P24 matrix are zero. F09 includes one explicitly mocked prior Node start for future postflight accounting, never an actual start in this phase. Shell/documentary interpreter invocations are not target execution.
